seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Video resolution tier. Wan 2.6 T2V only supports 720p and 1080p (no 480p).

prompt.description: The text prompt for video generation. Supports Chinese and English, max 1500 characters. For multi-shot videos, use format: 'Overall description. First shot [0-3s] content. Second shot [3-5s] content.'
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds. Choose between 5, 10, or 15 seconds.
duration.title: Duration

audio_url.description:
URL of the audio to use as the background music. Must be publicly accessible.
Limit handling: If the audio duration exceeds the duration value (5, 10, or 15 seconds),
the audio is truncated to the first N seconds, and the rest is discarded. If
the audio is shorter than the video, the remaining part of the video will be silent.
For example, if the audio is 3 seconds long and the video duration is 5 seconds, the
first 3 seconds of the output video will have sound, and the last 2 seconds will be silent.
- Format: WAV, MP3.
- Duration: 3 to 30 s.
- File size: Up to 15 MB.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to describe content to avoid. Max 500 characters.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

multi_shots.title: Multi Shots
multi_shots.description: When true, enables intelligent multi-shot segmentation for coherent narrative videos. Only active when enable_prompt_expansion is True. Set to false for single-shot generation.

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Whether to enable prompt rewriting using LLM. Improves results for short prompts but increases processing time.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Wan 2.6 supports additional ratios.

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

num_frames.title: Num Frames
num_frames.description: The number of frames in the video

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

examples:
Humorous but premium mini-trailer: a tiny fox 3D director proves "multi-scene" by calling simple commands that instantly change the set. Extreme photoreal 4K, cinematic lighting, subtle film grain, smooth camera. No subtitles, no UI, no watermark.

Shot 1 [0-3s] Macro close-up on the fox snapping a clapboard labeled "fal". the fox says : "Action."
Shot 2 [3-6s] Hard cut: Wild West street at sunset. Wide shot, dust in the air. The Fox (in frame) points forward: "Make it wide."
Shot 3 [6-10s] Hard cut: jungle river. The fox stands on a small boat. The camera pushes forward through vines and mist. Fox saying: "Now… adventure."
Shot 4 [10-15s] Hard cut: space station window. Slow orbit around the fox with stars outside. Fox nods: "Done. Next movie."
actual_prompt.description: The actual prompt used if prompt rewriting was enabled
actual_prompt.title: Actual Prompt
